connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -9.851) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm) touching the radiating edge y=-3.251 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

US3_MS2.note: Single variable: the last 6.60 mm of the 50 ohm line become a ~102 ohm lambda/4 transformer. Patch, U-slot, material, h, board, 50 ohm line width, port position/type and mesh profile unchanged.

rationale: Round 22 (US3_MS2) measured the edge-fed U-slot: R_edge 243-296 ohm, Q 16.25 at the patch edge, S11 -2.4..-3.9 dB with a direct 50 ohm feed. A ~100 ohm quarter-wave transformer (sqrt(50*~210 ohm effective)) is the round-22 next_task. Length: the round-22 guide sweep (ideal line, static eps_eff, edge-plane data) gave ~5.5 mm; re-designed here from the PORT-plane EM data with dispersive eps_eff (Kirschning-Jansen) for both line widths, the optimum is 6.6 mm (> lambda_g/4 = 5.2 mm because the transformer also absorbs the edge series inductance ~0.78 nH). At 5.5 mm the same model predicts only -4.5 dB worst. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11 claimed.

computation.method: em/circuit_fits/US3_MS3_qw_design.py: US3_MS2 port-plane Zin (EM, round 22) de-embedded over 9.749 mm of 50 ohm line (KJ dispersive eps_eff, scale 0.95/1.00/1.05), lossless transformer (static HJ Z0, KJ eps_eff), remaining 50 ohm line. Step discontinuity, transformer radiation and coupling NOT modelled. GUIDE_MODEL.

purpose: Match the edge-fed U-slot (US3_MS2) to the 50 ohm lumped port at the line start with a single quarter-wave transformer, owner feed rule 2026-11-05.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Base mesh, 50 ohm lumped port at y=-13: worst |S11| in 7.7376-8.2368 GHz <= -6.5 dB (>= 0.5 dB margin over -6 dB).
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: Radiation efficiency > 0.70 in the channel and Dmax within 20 deg of broadside (the transformer matches the line, so line/mismatch loss of US3_MS2 should drop).
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 holds -> next round: same variant on the fine mesh (two-mesh convergence check, owner rule). Worst in (-6.5, -6] dB -> marginal, fine mesh before any length change. Worst > -6 dB -> recalibrate l_t (and Zt) from the EM port-plane response of this run (do not sweep blindly); if the EM optimum of a single lambda/4 is still > -6 dB, report and reconsider topology (double-section or inset+QW).
pre_registered_hypothesis.note: Guide sensitivity to eps_eff (+-5 %) is large (-7.55 -> -5.6 dB): the result is a real test, not a foregone conclusion.

mesh_hint_note: Hard y line at -0.215 mm (inside the U-slot base, metal-free): microstrip_edge_qw adds plain y lines across the slot (<= 0.3 mm), which without this hint gave a y grading ratio 1.507 > 1.5 near y -0.37..-0.07 mm. Found by prepare-only trials (round 23).
